title: DialogBench: Evaluating LLMs as Human-like Dialogue Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Counting the frequency of different topics and domains in GPT-4 generated evaluation instances to detect imbalanced, long-tail distributions in the dataset.
Classifying generated dialogues into friendly, neutral, and unfriendly styles and calculating their proportions to identify an overrepresentation of friendly tone and lack of adversarial scenarios.
Calculating the accuracy of LLMs when the correct multiple-choice answers are placed in different option positions to detect innate selection preferences.
